title: %filter — keep array elements matching a condition
purpose: Filter an array of objects to the rows where a field matches a value.
notes: The field, operator, and value are three separate quoted arguments — not one condition string.
The kept rows are emitted as a relative tabular sub-block ({.active[] : ...}) under the output section.

avoid.why: the condition is three arguments (field, op, value), not one quoted infix string; a single string raises a verb-arity error
